subject: planner: fix join reorder correctness with conflict detection algorithm (#65705)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent: it adds a CD-C conflict-detection join-reorder implementation under `pkg/planner/core/joinorder/*`, wires it behind the `enableCDCJoinReorder` failpoint in `pkg/planner/core/rule_join_reorder.go`, and adds an `intest.Assert` guard to keep `base.JoinType` numeric values stable for rule-table indexing. No Blocker/High issues found in planner correctness/SQL semantics: non-inner reorders are gated (only LEFT/RIGHT OUTER with at least one non-NullEQ equi condition), applicability checks enforce conflict rules and side semantics, and the optimizer returns the original join-group root if it cannot consume all predicate edges. The added casetest suite cross-validates query results against the existing join reorder across many cases.
